title: Billing outage summary
prompt:
Summarize this incident in 40 to 80 words. Keep every fact below. Do not invent a different cause.

Source: The billing API failed at 09:40 UTC. It was down for 27 minutes. The cause was an expired certificate. About 1200 users saw failed checkouts. The service recovered after the certificate was renewed.

The summary must mention billing, 09:40, 27 minutes, certificate, and 1200. Do not write "unknown cause".
